newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 91day T-bills at 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 120 mln 91day T-bills at 9.5 pct.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it sold 120 million kuna worth of 91-day T-bills at a single annual rate of 9.50 percent at a first auction.
The issue was targeted at 50 million kuna originally, but was overshot by 111.3 million, it said in a statement.
The weighted bid rate was 9.67 percent, with a range between 7.50 and 15 percent at prices between 98.164 and 96.395.
On September 3, the ministry issued 120 million kuna of 45-day T-bills at 10 percent, down from 16 percent previously.
Foreign investors have no direct access to T-bill auctions.
